[[File:ChancellorsPodium-DoM.png|thumb|right|250px|The Chancellor's Podium in the center of the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]]]]
The '''Chancellor's Podium''' was a thirty-meter-tall podium in the center of the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. Its location suggested that of central attention yet vulnerability to that of the presiding body.

The [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], the [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]], and the Chancellor's [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Staff Aide]] were the only ones who could sit in the podium while the [[Official Reporter/Legends|Senate scribe]], [[Journal Clerk/Legends|journal clerk]], [[Parliamentarian/Legends|parliamentarian]], and [[Sergeant-at-Arms/Legends|Sergeant at Arms]] sat in a level below them.

When the podium was not in session, it would rest in the [[Chancellor's working office/Legends|Chancellor's holding office]], which was directly below. It also had controls for the senator's [[Repulsorpod/Legends|repulsorpods]].

When the Empire rose to power, the podium was no longer occupied by the Chancellor but by the [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]].
